lens: Fictionalized Margaret Morse lens: inhabited systems
readerSummary: Jamie is a technical project manager and implementation lead whose operating structures grow from how people actually gather, describe a scene, make decisions, preserve context, and continue together. Hospitality and artistic experimentation remain visible as practical origins of the work; they do not displace the professional role.

criteria.evidence: The live /about section 'Systems people can inhabit' connects Open House, WOWList, Sunday Dinner/196, coalition work and Knowledge Wiki Graphs, explicitly joining artistic, civic, technical and social practice. The page opens with the literal technical project manager and implementation lead role; the home hero states that role on desktop and mobile.

Three distinct continuities are inspectable: Sunday Dinner/196 converts hospitality and participant agency into invitation and residency handoffs; WOWList converts community language and Sunday Dinner calendars into collaborative event publishing and organizer support; coalition work converts listening, cultural-space care and collective meetings into action interfaces and recoverable memory. Detailed traces follow.

The portfolio explains inhabitation concretely: a resident artist gains independent working conditions, organizers can use the vocabulary of their own scenes, and coalition participants can recover context and carry decisions forward. 'Recognize their relationships, participate, remember what happened, and continue the work' is substantiated by these specific actions.

Open House remains a short cited projection and public source note, with communal governance and participant documentation credited collectively. WOWList names Richard Caceres; Sunday Dinner names its community and public co-organizer credit; coalition outcomes stay collective. Reviewed public surfaces and registry contained no protected educational text, faculty testimonial, participant rows, private correspondence, or raw Open House article. Photography metadata records publicGit/staging approval while production/indexing remain open.
Individual score is 4. This judge cannot determine the other two scores or the median.
